title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in bPlugins Flash &…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in bPlugins Flash & HTML5 Video html5-video-player up to version 2.14.1. This vulnerability is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of the affected web application.
